metrics.name: views
metrics.label: Views
metrics.description: Total GitHub page views. May include automated activity.

metrics.name: clones
metrics.label: Clones
metrics.description: Total GitHub clones; not installations or active users.

metrics.name: visitor_days
metrics.label: Visitor Days
metrics.description: Sum of daily unique visitors. Counts the same visitor again on another day or repository.

metrics.name: cloner_days
metrics.label: Cloner Days
metrics.description: Sum of daily unique cloners. Not distinct people over the whole period.

metrics.name: observed_traffic_days
metrics.label: Observed Traffic Days
metrics.description: Observed repository-days. Compare to expected repository-days to check coverage.

metrics.name: stars_observed
metrics.label: Stars Observed
metrics.description: Last observed repository star total within each time bucket, separately per repository.

metrics.name: forks_observed
metrics.label: Forks Observed
metrics.description: Last observed repository fork total within each time bucket, separately per repository.

metrics.name: stars_net_change
metrics.label: Stars Net Change
metrics.description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.

metrics.name: forks_net_change
metrics.label: Forks Net Change
metrics.description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.

metrics.name: legacy_stars_cumulative
metrics.label: Legacy Stars Cumulative
metrics.description: Upstream reconstructed star history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical observed totals.

metrics.name: legacy_forks_cumulative
metrics.label: Legacy Forks Cumulative
metrics.description: Upstream reconstructed fork history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical observed totals.

metrics.name: referrer_views_14d
metrics.label: Referrer Views 14D
metrics.description: Reported referrer views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never sum snapshots.

metrics.name: referrer_visitor_observations_14d
metrics.label: Referrer Visitor Observations 14D
metrics.description: Reported referrer unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.

metrics.name: path_views_14d
metrics.label: Path Views 14D
metrics.description: Reported path views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never sum snapshots.

metrics.name: path_visitor_observations_14d
metrics.label: Path Visitor Observations 14D
metrics.description: Reported path unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.

metrics.name: views_per_visitor_day
metrics.label: Views Per Visitor Day
metrics.description: Ratio of sums. Zero denominator returns null.

metrics.name: clones_per_cloner_day
metrics.label: Clones Per Cloner Day
metrics.description: Ratio of sums. Zero denominator returns null.
